figurative_meaning_en: A person who fulfills one's heart's desires
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আমার জীবনের বাঞ্ছারাম, সব স্বপ্ন পূরণ করে দিয়েছে।
তোমার বাঞ্ছারাম কে, যে তোমার প্রত্যেক ইচ্ছা মেনে নেয়?
example_sentences_in_english: He is the wish-fulfiller of my life, having granted all my dreams.
Who is your wish-granter, the one who indulges your every desire?
history: Derived from Hindu mythology, referencing Lord Rama as a divine figure who grants boons and fulfills devotees' wishes in the Ramayana.
note: The idiom draws from religious reverence for Rama, often used endearingly in everyday Bengali speech.
